## [Daemon](@id ref-fam-daemon-daemon)

**See guide:** [Resident Worker Daemon ADR](@ref int-daemon-adr)

### [`frdc daemon start`](@id ref-daemon-start)

Start the opt-in resident worker daemon (FRDC_DAEMON=1) for the current build stamp and thread count

| Option | Short | Type | Default | Choices | Description |
|--------|-------|------|---------|---------|-------------|
| `--ttl` | — | `Int64` | `600` | — | Idle shutdown timeout in seconds (default: 600; env: FRDC_DAEMON_TTL) |
| `--max-rss-mb` | — | `Int64` | `2048` | — | Per-worker soft RSS recycle ceiling in MiB (default: 2048; env: FRDC_DAEMON_MAX_RSS_MB) |
| `--format` | `-f` | `String` | `table` | `table`, `csv`, `json` | Output format |
| `--output` | `-o` | `String` | `""` | — | Write to file instead of stdout |

**Output tables:** `daemon_status` (Daemon lifecycle status, PID, IPC endpoint, build stamp, threads, RSS, and limits)

### [`frdc daemon status`](@id ref-daemon-status)

| Option | Short | Type | Default | Choices | Description |
|--------|-------|------|---------|---------|-------------|
| `--format` | `-f` | `String` | `table` | `table`, `csv`, `json` | Output format |
| `--output` | `-o` | `String` | `""` | — | Write to file instead of stdout |

**Output tables:** `daemon_status` (Daemon health status, PID, endpoint, threads, RSS MiB, requests served, and limits)

### [`frdc daemon stop`](@id ref-daemon-stop)

Gracefully stop the resident worker daemon for the current build stamp and thread count

| Option | Short | Type | Default | Choices | Description |
|--------|-------|------|---------|---------|-------------|
| `--format` | `-f` | `String` | `table` | `table`, `csv`, `json` | Output format |
| `--output` | `-o` | `String` | `""` | — | Write to file instead of stdout |

**Output tables:** `daemon_status` (Daemon stop status, former PID, and IPC endpoint)
